PROJECT 01 / FULL STACK

Drivly

Vehicle sharing for residential communities.

A peer-to-peer booking application built with Next.js, TypeScript, Prisma, and PostgreSQL.

Booking consistency
Checks for overlapping bookings inside a database transaction, with a lock on the vehicle row.

Server-side pricing
Calculates booking prices from stored vehicle rates instead of trusting a client-supplied price.

Account access
JWT authentication and multi-user booking workflows.

03 / OPEN SOURCE

Small fixes.
Public evidence.

Selected merged contributions. Each link leads to the implementation, tests, and review discussion.

Fleet #54411

Correct return navigation from live runs

Cancel and Close in live reports and policies now return to where the run started (Details, Edit, or the unsaved form), built on the existing route builders.

Merged Fleet #55097

No more silently dropped profile settings

Reject incorrectly typed custom profile paths and labels in fleetctl apply instead of reporting success with incomplete settings.

Merged Fleet #53407

Fail-fast batch software uploads

Stop processing and downloading the remaining packages once one package in a batch upload fails, using a cancellable errgroup context.

Merged Fleet #54726

Run policy on Unassigned for Observer+

Fix a truthiness check that treated fleet ID 0 (Unassigned) as no fleet, which hid the Run policy action.

Merged Superserve #356

MCP network-log pagination

Forward opaque cursors so callers can retrieve the next page of network events. Added regression coverage for the request contract.

Merged Fleet #53810

Recognizable script packages

Distinguish script packages in software lists and make search match the displayed names.

Merged Fleet #54296

Accurate script timeout messages

Use the server's execution status for the timeout message while preserving the script's actual output.

Merged Superserve #330

Reliable development builds

Prevent the development watcher from deleting the HTTP entry point produced by the other build.

Merged Fleet #54509

Live report tooltip for locked hosts

Restore the tooltip that explains the Live report action for locked hosts.
